newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker levels firm amid berth congestion.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker levels firm amid berth congestion.

text.p: Singapore bunker levels firmed on Tuesday amid berth congestion but traders said enquiries levels were not high enough to trigger major gains.
"In the short term prices should remain firm," said one trader with a major. Another trader saw the month-end berth congestion as "routine" and did not expect further gains.
Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at about $102/$104 per tonne and the 180-cst grade was at around $104/$106.
MDO and gas oil were at around $170 and $180 per tonne respectively, traders said.
